integrity: Direct finite-field tests confirm small prime-field cases. An algebraic proof establishes the general identity; independent audit has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the path algebras of four-vertex consecutive multiarrow line quivers and the all-ones projective summand vector. The one-arrow case is classical. No general polynomiality claim for arbitrary quivers or projective multiplicities. Earlier equivalent tensor-rank formulations are a residual publication-priority risk.
title: Commuting-pair polynomial for the three-step multiarrow line quiver
